name: SQLite
about: No lab-tested knowledge yet: DBaba recognises SQLite from its words or error format and answers with general SQL reasoning plus the notes below.

notes.limit: LIMIT n OFFSET m works as on MySQL/PostgreSQL.
notes.concat: || joins text on SQLite; CONCAT() exists only from 3.44.
notes.full_join: RIGHT and FULL OUTER JOIN exist only from SQLite 3.39.
